sections.title: FEX (x86 emulation)
sections.help: How the game's x86 code runs on the ARM CPU. Try these when a game crashes, hangs or glitches at random.

sections.title: Graphics
sections.help: DXVK (DirectX 8-11), vkd3d-proton (DirectX 12) and Turnip, the GPU driver.

options.label: TSO emulation
options.help: Keeps x86 memory ordering between threads. Off is faster, but most multithreaded games crash or hang without it.

options.label: Vector TSO
options.help: Also orders vector (SSE/AVX) loads and stores. Fixes some random crashes and corrupted data; slower.

options.label: memcpy/memset TSO
options.help: Also orders REP MOVS/STOS copies. Fixes some crashes in games that copy between threads; slower.

options.label: Half-barrier TSO
options.help: A faster shortcut for unaligned memory access. Off is fully atomic and safer.

options.label: Use volatile metadata
options.help: Lets the game's own hints relax TSO where it's safe. Off applies TSO everywhere: slower, sometimes more stable.

options.label: Strict split locks
options.help: Locks atomics that cross a cache line. Fixes rare hangs and corrupted state; slower.

options.label: Self-modifying code checks
options.help: How FEX notices code the game rewrites (anti-tamper, DRM, JITs). Full fixes crashes in those games but is slow.

options.label: x87 precision
options.help: Older and 32-bit games do floating point on the x87 unit. Full precision fixes physics, camera or geometry glitches.

options.label: Multiblock
options.help: Compiles bigger chunks of code at once: faster code, but longer compile stutters.

options.label: Block size
options.help: Most instructions per compiled block. Smaller compiles faster (less stutter), larger runs faster.

options.label: Mono (Unity) hacks
options.help: Special handling for games on Mono, such as many Unity games. Turn off if one of those crashes at start.

options.label: Hide hypervisor
options.help: Hides the 'running in a virtual machine' CPU flag, which some DRM and anti-cheat refuse.

options.label: Report GPU as
options.help: For DirectX 9-11 games that refuse to start on an unknown GPU ("unsupported graphics card").

options.label: Report video memory
options.help: For DirectX 9-11 games that refuse to start, or pick low textures, because of the shared GPU memory.

options.label: DXVK HUD
options.help: DXVK's overlay: frame rate, or also shader compiles (to see where stutter comes from).

options.label: DirectX 12 feature level
options.help: For DirectX 12 games that say the GPU doesn't meet the requirements.

options.label: DirectX 12 shader model
options.help: For DirectX 12 games that check for a newer shader model.

options.label: Hide ray tracing (DX12)
options.help: Turns DirectX ray tracing off, for games that crash when they find it.

options.label: Static constant buffers (DX12)
options.help: A workaround some DirectX 12 games need for missing or flickering geometry.

options.label: Single queue (DX12)
options.help: Runs all GPU work on one queue. Can fix GPU hangs and device-lost crashes; may be slower.

options.label: Turnip: no tiling (sysmem)
options.help: Renders straight to memory instead of in tiles. Fixes some corrupted or flickering images; slower.

options.label: Turnip: no LRZ
options.help: Turns the early depth test off. Fixes some missing or flickering objects.

options.label: Turnip: no compression (UBWC)
options.help: Turns framebuffer compression off. Fixes some corrupted textures; uses more memory bandwidth.

options.label: Turnip: sync every draw
options.help: Waits for each draw to finish. Only for chasing GPU hangs: very slow.

options.label: Use WineD3D
options.help: Wine's own OpenGL-based DirectX 9-11 instead of DXVK. A last resort for older games that render wrong; slower.

options.label: Hide DirectX 12
options.help: Makes games that also have a DirectX 11 renderer use it.

options.label: Hide DirectX 11
options.help: Makes games that also have a DirectX 9 renderer use it.

options.label: Disable esync
options.help: Turn off if a game hangs or crashes at random. Can cost some performance.

options.label: Disable fsync
options.help: Turn off if a game hangs or crashes at random. Can cost some performance.

options.label: Delay heap frees
options.help: Works around games that use memory after freeing it (random crashes).

options.label: Proton log
options.help: Writes steam-<app id>.log to your home folder, for bug reports. Slows the game down a little.

presets.label: FEX: fastest
presets.help: Least emulation overhead. Start here for performance.

presets.label: FEX: safer
presets.help: Stricter memory ordering. Try this first when a game crashes or hangs at random.

presets.label: FEX: most accurate
presets.help: Everything strict, full x87 precision, full code checks. Slow; for games nothing else fixes.

presets.label: 32-bit game: full x87 precision
presets.help: 32-bit games do their floating point on the x87 unit, which FEX runs at reduced precision for speed (64-bit games hardly use it). Full precision fixes physics, camera and geometry glitches in them; a little slower.

presets.label: DirectX 12: pass GPU checks
presets.help: For DirectX 12 games that stop at "GPU does not meet the minimum requirements".

presets.label: DirectX 11: pass GPU checks
presets.help: For DirectX 9-11 games that refuse an unknown GPU or its shared memory.

presets.label: GPU hangs
presets.help: For games that freeze the screen or end with a lost GPU.
